get_function_module: get the function module by its ID from cache or database
get_sorted_filter_ids: get sorted filter IDs for a model, respecting priority and active status
process_filter_functions: process inlet, outlet, or stream filter functions on request form data
run_filter_with_valves: run a filter function with applied valves and user-specific configuration
build_filter_pipeline: build a filter pipeline that processes form data through sorted filter functions
